text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Official sources reveal information about a conspiracy to assassinate the Pope during his weekend visit to Lebanon.
- Parliament Speaker Berri meets President Mubarak in Cairo.
- President Hrawi receives the Apostolic Exhortation for Lebanon.
- The "Islamic Resistance" storms into the Sojoud outpost in south Lebanon. One Israeli soldier and four militiamen wounded.
- Economic delegation accompanies Foreign Minister Bouez on his official trip to Romania.
- Israeli air raids on Hizbollah bases in the Iqlim al-Toufah area after the attack on Sojoud outpost.
- Yields on Lebanese treasury bills remain stable. The May 8 issue posts a nominal surplus of subscription against maturity of 107 billion pounds.
- A terrorist group bought 23 missiles to blow up the Pope's plane during his Lebanon visit. Beirut stepped up security measures after reports from Canadian Interpol.
- Arab and International trade union organisations support the leadership of opposition Elias Abou Rizk against loyalist Ghneim al-Zoghby.
